name: Echizen (Japan, city)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Echizen city emblem in green, orange and blue: three curved strokes in green, orange and blue, like stylised leaves.
history: Municipal flag of Echizen, a city in Fukui Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 2004.

features.role: Echizen city emblem — three curved strokes in green, orange and blue, like stylised leaves
